title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 46
description: Ten questions on Genesis 46: Jacob's journey to Egypt, the names of his family and his meeting with Joseph.

questions.text: Where did Israel offer sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac?
questions.explanation: Israel traveled with all that he had, came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.

questions.text: What did God promise to make of Jacob in Egypt?
questions.explanation: God said, "Don't be afraid to go down into Egypt, for there I will make of you a great nation."

questions.text: What did God say Joseph's hand would do?
questions.explanation: God told Jacob, "Joseph's hand will close your eyes."

questions.text: Who is named as Jacob's firstborn?
questions.explanation: The list of the children of Israel who came into Egypt begins with "Reuben, Jacob's firstborn."

questions.text: Which of Judah's sons died in the land of Canaan?
questions.explanation: The sons of Judah were Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez and Zerah, "but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan."

questions.text: Who bore Manasseh and Ephraim to Joseph in Egypt?
questions.explanation: Manasseh and Ephraim were born to Joseph in Egypt; Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore them.

questions.text: How many souls of the house of Jacob came into Egypt in total?
questions.explanation: Genesis 46:27 says all the souls of the house of Jacob who came into Egypt were seventy.

questions.text: Whom did Jacob send ahead to Joseph to show the way to Goshen?
questions.explanation: Jacob sent Judah before him to Joseph, to show the way before him to Goshen.

questions.text: What did Israel say to Joseph after they met in Goshen?
questions.explanation: Israel said to Joseph, "Now let me die, since I have seen your face, that you are still alive."

answers.text: "Why did you not send for me sooner?"
"Now let me die, since I have seen your face"
"Take me back to the land of Canaan now"
"Show me the house where you live in Egypt"

questions.text: What did Joseph say every shepherd is to the Egyptians?
questions.explanation: Joseph told his brothers to say they were keepers of livestock, so they could dwell in Goshen, "for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians."
